description: Eight wavetable oscillators from the Namco 163 cartridge chip, sharing one morphable waveform

params.text: Sets the pitch of that oscillator, two and a half octaves either side of C4
Attenuates the voltage at that oscillator's FM jack before it is added to the pitch, and inverts it below zero
Sets the level of that oscillator, 0 to 15
Sets how many of the eight oscillators the chip runs, 1 to 8; the chip divides its time between them, so more oscillators means a duller, grainier sound
Attenuates the voltage at the CHANNELS jack before it is added to the CHANNELS knob, and inverts it below zero
Morphs between the five drawn waveforms, 1 to 5, interpolating sample by sample between neighbouring pairs
Attenuates the voltage at the WAVEFORM jack before it is added to the WAVEFORM knob, and inverts it below zero

inputs.text: Raises the pitch of that oscillator by a volt per octave; unpatched it reads the V/OCT jack of the oscillator above it, and the first oscillator reads 0V
Modulates the pitch of that oscillator, a full octave per 5V with the FM knob wide open; unpatched it reads the FM jack of the oscillator above it, and the first oscillator reads 5V
Scales that oscillator's AMP knob, 10V leaving it untouched and 0V silencing it; unpatched it reads the AMP jack of the oscillator above it, and the first oscillator reads 10V
Sets how many oscillators the chip runs, through the attenuverter beneath the CHANNELS knob, 10V spanning all eight
Moves the waveform morph through its own attenuverter, 7V spanning all five waveforms

outputs.text: Carries that oscillator's wave, hard clipped at 5V, with the wave of any earlier oscillator whose own output is unpatched added in

notes: the five waveform displays are drawn on with the mouse: drag across one to reshape it. The WAVEFORM knob morphs between them in the order red, green, blue, yellow, white
the eight outputs are chained: an oscillator whose output is left unpatched is summed into the next output down, so patching only the last output gives a mix of all eight
raising CHANNELS does not retune the oscillators, unlike the original chip, because the frequency register is computed without reference to the channel count
